title: 5 Signs Your Priorities Are Out of Alignment
paragraphs: 5 Signs Your Priorities Are Out of Alignment
You’re busy… but somehow still empty.

That’s not exhaustion.
That’s misalignment.

You’re doing a lot.
But are you doing what matters to God?

Let me say this with love—
You can win at everything… and still lose your soul.
Here are 5 signs your priorities are out of alignment:

1. You have time for everything… except God.
Endless scrolling. Non-stop hustle.
But prayer feels like a burden.

Jesus said, “Seek first the Kingdom…” (Matthew 6:33)
Not second. Not when convenient.
First.

2. You’re chasing success but neglecting your soul.
You’re building a name. A brand. A future.
But your spirit is starving.
“What does it profit a man to gain the whole world… and lose his soul?” (Mark 8:36)

3. You feel constant anxiety—even when things are going well.
Because deep down…
You know something’s off.
Misaligned priorities always produce internal unrest.

Peace isn’t found in control.
It’s found in surrender.

4. You compromise small things—and call it “normal.”
Little lies. Hidden habits. Quiet disobedience.
You say, “It’s not that serious.”

But sin doesn’t shout at first.
It whispers… then it owns.

5. God only becomes real when you’re in trouble.
You pray when you’re desperate.
But ignore Him when you’re stable.

That’s not relationship.
That’s emergency contact.
But here’s what we miss…

God is not trying to take your life.
He’s trying to restore it.

Misalignment isn’t the end.
It’s an invitation.
An invitation to come back.

To realign.
To repent.
To return.

Because Jesus didn’t die just to forgive you—
He died to lead you.

Back to truth.
Back to purpose.
Back to Him.
If this hit your heart… don’t ignore it.
Realign today.

Not tomorrow.
Not when life slows down.
Now.
Because one decision can shift your eternity.

From chaos to calling.
From distraction to devotion.
From lost… to found.
